title: TV launcher banner is a bare ring with no name
body: banner.xml is a ring and a white block with no wordmark; the Fire TV home shows the tile with only the label under it. Needs art (leonardo) - product decision.

title: Android assets.open failure at start is a crash with no word
body: MainActivity asset loader throws raw IOException; also the debug-only IllegalStateException text names -PsilentMmap (dev speak, debug only).

title: Desktop window title never shows the pairing address
body: Title is static Death Ride; desktop testers must read stdout for the URL. Seam: game exposes pairingUrl; Launcher could set the window title after start.

title: Story cards: three lines of up to 78 chars each (line1-3) plus 190-char campaign-beats beat
body: Owned by narrative/lines.csv (voice-tied); cutting text means re-recording audio. TV caption slot should show line1 only, lines 2-3 on advance.

title: Jargon in the economy: CR, PR, tier, cup points, trophies have no first-use expansion; "Debt" means two things (league debt vs optional loan)
body: Pick one word each: "Crew debt" / "Loan"; show CR as the coin glyph on both screens.

title: lines.csv voice_direction up to 137 chars and tracks.csv lesson (84) are authoring fields; confirm no consumer prints them
body: Grep found none on phone/TV; keep out of any JSON before it is added.

title: Garage/career/car/track hud payloads carry prose the phone prints (messages, lessons, descriptions)
body: Metadata blobs (garage.message, saveStatus, career.message, track.lesson, difficulty.description) are authored in game/core and rendered verbatim on the phone; cutting them is a core/game change plus a controller change.

title: Server strings the phone prints verbatim are long
body: layout.description, track.lesson, g.message+saveStatus, c.message, story lines, rival taunt, ally line, offer description/reason, pairing error message are server/CSV text with no budget. Needs a length budget test over controller-layouts.csv, tracks lesson, difficulties description, campaign-mechanic.csv (core paths, other context).

title: CR/credits unit and PR units have no TV agreement
body: Money is CR everywhere on the phone; confirm the TV shows the same unit and Hull % / Power wording.

title: Garage offers: 3-column cards with 11px copy at 3 m is wrong; phone is hand-held but 11px description plus delta plus button per part is dense
body: Show name, tier dots, one stat delta and a single button; description behind tap. Needs layout redesign and a catalog description cut.

title: Mine is both a weapon and the Mechanic's ability (Mine vs Mine Dispatcher); Turbine ability vs Turbo reserve consumable vs Hot fuel
body: Two names for near-same boost/drop things. Product decision on a rename (e.g. ability 'Auto Mines', consumable 'Boost reserve').

title: Ability names are nouns, not verbs (Shoulder, Scrambler, Flywheel)
body: Button says the thing, not what it does: Scrambler (slick patch), Shoulder (ram charge), Flywheel (surge). Rename to verb-led short names or add a one-word effect line per ability.

title: No presentation event for ability active / ready-again / blocked press / weapon overheat lock
body: PresentationKind.ABILITY fires only at windup. Ready-again, a rejected press (arming, cooldown, low energy), and the weapon heat lockout/resume have no event, so TV and phone cannot cue them. Adding enum values breaks the exhaustive when in RaceAudioDirector.kt:92-101 (game), so needs a coordinated change. DESIGN: one coordinated card. New kinds proposed: ABILITY_ACTIVE, ABILITY_READY, ABILITY_REFUSED(detail=reason), WEAPON_LOCKED, WEAPON_RESUMED. Exhaustive when sites a new PresentationKind breaks: game/src/main/kotlin/dev/deathride/game/audio/RaceAudioDirector.kt lines 91-101 (when(event.kind) used as an expression, one branch per kind, no else) - add a branch (or else->continue) for each; the if-chains at 103-104 are non-exhaustive and safe. Test sites using kinds non-exhaustively: core PresentationEventsTest, TrackQualitySimulation.kt:130-138 (check for exhaustive when). Emit sites: Abilities.activate, Abilities.begin phase transitions, Combat.kt:239 (lock) and :249 (resume). Events never hash; emit only when presentationEvents.enabled.

title: Four in-race barks over one caption line (60+ chars)
body: bark.mica.a5.marrow 83, bark.rook.grudge.wrecked 80 (repeats a sentence), bark.vex.ally.grid 70, bark.mica.noname 67; 32 announcer lines over 60 too. Core resource lines.csv must equal narrative/lines.csv (ScriptTest), so the edit lands in narrative/ first. Add a bark/taunt <=64 budget test with it. AUDIO NOTE: announcer lines are Callum noir voice rows; rewording any line with a recorded counterpart (rec.* / recorded-keep|replace) means a re-record, so this is lane C: owner decides cut vs re-record. Barks are UNCAST drafts and can be shortened freely.

title: Speaker name for unknown speakers is uppercase of the id
body: Script.speakerName maps only voice/mechanic/house; relay and clerk speakers would show RELAY / CLERK without the article/role used elsewhere. Add explicit names.

title: Weapons have no display name; the phone shows the id (Rivet/Hammer/Scatter/Mine)
body: weaponName is Weapons.id; weapons.csv has no name column and no verb. Add a name column (e.g. RIVET gun, HAMMER shell) via the table, tests budget it.

title: PR and CR are unexplained jargon on both screens
body: Summary: rivals show 'PR 120 / 800 CR / GRUDGE'; footer shows '120 CR'. PR (power rating) is never defined; CR reads as a currency only to people who already know. Phone market uses the same shorthand. Proposal: one name each decided with the phone (e.g. a car icon + number for power, a coin icon + number for credits).
gate: needs icon art from art context

title: Garage and results have no picture of the thing being discussed
body: Summary: garage lists parts as words with before > after stat text beside bars (numbers twice); the car itself is not on screen (the lobby shows it). Results is six text rows with no podium or car sprites. Proposal: car sprite large in garage with stat bars changing live, delta chips only on the selected part; results podium of three car sprites with the other three as small rows. Shop/save line 'Parts stay with this car / New profile' is internal jargon (RaceGame.kt:108-109,822).
gate: screenshot walk, perf pair for added sprites

title: Cars wear their loadout: weapons and armour visibly mounted on every car
body:
## Summary
The garage choice is invisible on the track: all 62 mount rows in mount-attachments.csv draw tinted rectangles (0 of 76 rows has a sprite) and armour has no art at all. Recommended direction: cars wear their loadout, weapons and armour tiers as owner-approved sprites mounted on every car, with today's silhouettes as the fallback.
## Why
At 3 m the player cannot tell Rivet from Hammer by anything but the HUD, and the buy in the garage has no visible result (tv-16). Of the art gaps measured today this is the only one that shows on every car for the whole race; HUD glyphs, banner and ability approvals each touch one screen.
## Proposal
Fill the sprite column; add an equip row type keyed class x kind x tier; ship bundle phase3-mounts (46 weapon sprites + 30 armour plates, or 8 shared designs) on one page, drawn in one batch pass. Phase 0 ships procedural tiered plates and the garage car picture with zero images. Details: docs/concepts/deathride/DESIGN-CARD-CARS-WEAR-LOADOUT.md, coverage in ART-GAPS-2026-10-15.md.
## Gate
Direction for the owner: (1) clear or fund the Grok latch (usage.json stop 2026-10-04, HTTP 402) or approve a Gemini pilot with a hard cap of 30 images; (2) approve proof before batch. Image ceiling 24 shared, 252 full, against weekly cap 850.
## Measure
Every installed weapon on every one of 10 classes draws a sprite not a silhouette; <= 2 extra texture switches and 0 allocations per frame on the Stick matched pair; damage states keep mounts; garage preview pixel-matches the race car.
evidence: game/src/main/resources/mounts/mount-attachments.csv (76 rows, sprite empty on all, Armor 10 all none); game/.../MountPainter.kt:10-18,56-67; AtlasArt.kt:141-142; core/.../parts.csv; assets/phase2-states/catalog.json (4 of 41 ui approved); art/usage.json stop 2026-10-04; art/budget.json; findings tv-13, tv-16, dr-app-desktop-3, RC-10
